descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer with German language skills to support strategic and operational security initiatives in an evolving technology environment.
 Key Responsibilities:
Cloud Security: Support security initiatives related to cloud environments, ensuring that security requirements and best practices are considered during the design, implementation, and operation of cloud-based solutions.
Agentic AI Security: Contribute to the assessment of security risks associated with Agentic AI solutions, AI-enabled workflows, and integrations with external tools and services.
Threat Modeling: Identify potential threats, attack vectors, and security weaknesses in applications, systems, and architectures, and support the definition of appropriate mitigation measures.
Vulnerability Management: Assist with identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and tracking vulnerabilities, working with relevant technical teams to support timely remediation.
SaaS Security and Integrations: Support the security assessment of SaaS platforms, third-party integrations, and connected services, with a focus on identifying and mitigating potential risks.
Security Consulting: Provide security guidance and recommendations to technical teams and stakeholders, helping them understand security requirements and implement appropriate controls.
Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Contribute to security reviews, risk assessments, and the development of actionable recommendations to address identified security gaps.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with existing security specialists, architects, developers, and other stakeholders to support both strategic security initiatives and day-to-day operational activities.
Continuous Improvement: Help improve security processes, methodologies, and documentation in response to emerging technologies, evolving threats, and changing business requirements.
 Required Skills:
Experience in IT security, information security, cloud security, or a related cybersecurity domain.
Understanding of cloud security principles, security controls, and common risks associated with cloud-based environments.
Knowledge of threat modeling, vulnerability management, and security risk assessment methodologies.
Understanding of Security by Design principles and secure architecture practices.
Awareness of emerging security challenges related to Agentic AI, AI-enabled applications, SaaS platforms, and third-party integrations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess security risks and propose practical mitigation measures.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain security concepts and recommendations clearly.
German language proficiency, enabling effective communication with German-speaking stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with existing security experts and cross-functional teams.
